Number of studies.evidence_source: The section describes a single set of statistical analyses applied to BAS-2 (e.g., “The hypothesized one-factor BAS-2 solution was analyzed using a confirmatory factor analysis (CFA).” and procedures for invariance, reliability, and validity for that sample).

section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical procedures used to evaluate the one-factor BAS-2 (confirmatory factor analysis with WLSMV on polychoric correlations), including tests of measurement invariance across gender and weight status, reliability (composite reliability, ICC), convergent/incremental validity, and latent mean differences via a MIMIC model. The sample is described as students clustered within different school centres (schools), and gender was coded (girls = 0, boys = 1) and weight status dichotomized (underweight/normoweight = 0, overweight/obese = 1).
